subtests.name: Adding two non-addable types in the CSSMathSum constructor throws TypeError
Adding two types with the same base type in the CSSMathSum constructor returns the same type
Adding two types with empty maps in the CSSMathSum constructor returns an empty map
Adding a type containing percent in the CSSMathSum constructor returns a type with a percent hint
Adding a squared length type and a percent type in the CSSMathSum constructor throws TypeError
Adding a type with a percent hint in the CSSMathSum constructor returns a type with the same percent hint
Adding two types with the same percent hint in the CSSMathSum constructor returns a type with that percent hint
